theorems.name: Submission.cmcsd_support_calculus
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), (∀ (E : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsClosed E → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) E → X ω = 0) → X.support ⊆ E) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, IsClosed X.support) ∧ (∀ A B : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, (A - B).support ⊆ A.support ∪ B.support) ∧ (0 : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n).support = ∅ ∧ (∀ A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 1), A.boundary.support ⊆ A.support)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
